name: of1-comparison-table
description: Side-by-side spec table comparing 2-4 plans across fixed feature rows, with a featured middle column, per-plan CTAs, and a shared-benefits list.

Label for the third comparison row, e.g. 'Data'.
Label for the fourth comparison row, e.g. 'Free Xfinity Mobile line'.
